content: पुण्य {%a.%} [<ls>Uṇ. 5. 15</ls>] .²1 Holy, sacred, pure; जनकतनयास्नानपुण्योदकेषु आश्रमेषु <ls>Me. 1</ls>; पुण्यं धाम चण्डीश्वरस्य <ls>Me. 35</ls>; पुण्यानि हि नामग्रहणान्यपि महामुनीनां किं पुनर्दर्शनानि <ls>K. 41</ls>; <ls>Ś. 2. 14</ls>; <ls>Ms. 2. 68</ls>. .²2 Good, meritorious, virtuous, righteous, just. .²3 Auspicious, propitious, lucky, favourable (as a day); <ls>Ms. 2. 26</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 2.">30</ls>. .²4 Agreeable, pleasing, lovely, beautiful; प्रकृत्या पुण्यलक्ष्मीकौ <ls>Mv. 1. 16</ls>, <ls n="Mv. 1.">24</ls>; <ls>U. 4. 19</ls>; <ls>Ku. 5. 73</ls>; so पुण्यदर्शनः <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 Sweet, fragrant (as odour). .²6 Solemn, festive. .{@-ण्यम्@} .²1 Virtue, religious or moral merit; अत्युत्कटैः पापपुण्यैरिहैव फलमश्नुते <ls>H. 1. 80</ls>; महतः पुण्यपण्येन कीतेयं कायनौस्त्वया <ls>Śānti. 3. 1</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 69</ls>; <ls>N. 3. 87</ls>. .²2 A virtuous or meritorious act, good or virtuous works. .²3 Purity, purification. .²4 A trough for watering cattle. .²5 A religious ceremony, especially one performed by a wife to retain her husbandʼs affection and to obtain a son. .²6 (<ab>Astrol.</ab>) the seventh mansion from जन्मलग्न. .²7 the union of मेष, कर्क, तुला and मकर. .{@-ण्या@} .²1 The holy basil. .²2 The Ganges.
